extensionDescription.message: Keeps selected tabs active with background requests and optional persistent website rules.

unsupportedTabNotice.message: Keep-alive cannot run on this page. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS website.

endpointHelp.message: Leave empty or enter a suitable URL on the same website.

tabSettingsHelp.message: Applies to this tab. Use “Remember this website” to save these settings permanently.

footnote.message: Requests, activity signals and renewal attempts do not confirm an active login. Fixed session limits and device sleep still apply.

beyondTrustIntervalNote.message: BeyondTrust uses activity signals: $p1$. Saved interval: $p2$. A custom keep-alive URL uses background requests.

nativeIntervalNote.message: $p1$ uses its own session renewal: $p2$. Saved interval: $p3$. A custom keep-alive URL uses background requests.

tabException.message: Tab exception until close or restart

sourceTab.message: Active until close or website change

ruleMissingAccess.message: Rule saved. Website access is missing.

ruleSavedDescription.message: Website rule saved. New matching tabs start automatically.

ruleStoredOff.message: Website rule saved and turned off.

ruleSavedSuccess.message: Website rule saved. It also applies after Chrome restarts.

tabRuleRestoredSuccess.message: This tab uses the website rule again.

optionsTagline.message: Remember once. Guard again after a restart.

optionsIntro.message: These rules enable keep-alive for matching open tabs and tabs you open later. They remain saved after a Chrome restart. To add a website, open the extension there and choose “Remember this website”.

emptyDescription.message: Open a website, then choose “Remember this website” in the popup.

explanationOrigin.message: A rule matches the same protocol, host and port. Subdomains are separate. The extension does not open tabs or reload pages. Unloaded or frozen tabs wait until their document can run.

explanationOverride.message: A tab exception takes priority over the website rule. It ends when the tab closes or Chrome restarts.

explanationProfiles.message: Recognized BeyondTrust consoles use activity signals. Guacamole and Proxmox VE use their own session interfaces. RDP Secure Access only monitors the loaded portal and adds no requests. The popup shows the actual interval; your saved interval stays unchanged. A custom keep-alive URL bypasses automatic profiles and sends background requests at your saved interval.

explanationLimit.message: Successful requests, activity signals and renewal attempts do not guarantee an active login. The website decides whether to extend a session; fixed session limits still apply. Nothing runs while Chrome is closed or the device is asleep.

footerLocal.message: Local to this device · No data sent to our own service

errorExtensionUnavailable.message: The extension is not responding. Please try again.

errorActionFailed.message: The action failed. Please try again.

errorInvalidInterval.message: Enter a whole number of minutes between 1 and 60.

errorEndpointScope.message: The keep-alive URL must belong to this exact website and must not contain credentials.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Website access was not granted. Persistent activation was not enabled.

errorPermissionRequest.message: Website access could not be requested. Open the extension on the website and try again.

runtimeIdle.message: Active. Waiting for the next attempt.

runtimeAppLoading.message: $p1$ is still loading. Waiting for the signed-in console.

runtimeBusy.message: An attempt is still running. The next attempt follows the schedule.

runtimeAuthRequired.message: $p1$: Sign-in required. Sign in, then resume.

runtimeHttpAuth.message: HTTP $p1$: Check your login or access, then resume.

runtimeRedirect.message: Redirect detected. Check the website, then resume.

runtimeActivitySent.message: $p1$: Activity signal sent. Server policy determines session lifetime.

runtimeRenewalSent.message: $p1$: Native session renewal attempted. Server policy determines session lifetime.

runtimeHttpSuccess.message: Request successful. The website decides whether the session is extended.

runtimeInjectionPermission.message: Script access failed. Check website access and enable the tab again.

runtimeInjectionUnavailable.message: The script could not run in this tab. Check the tab and extension.

runtimeNetworkError.message: Network request failed. The next attempt follows the schedule.

runtimeUnsupported.message: $p1$: This app version is not supported. Requests are paused.

runtimeUnsupportedAuth.message: $p1$: This authentication method is not supported. Requests are paused.

runtimeNativeError.message: $p1$: Native session renewal failed. The next attempt follows the schedule.

errorInvalidWebsite.message: Choose a valid HTTP or HTTPS website.

errorEndpointOrigin.message: The keep-alive URL must belong to the same website.

errorUnsupportedTab.message: This tab is not supported. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS website.

errorInternal.message: An internal error occurred. Please try again.

badgeActive.description: Toolbar badge for normal active keep-alive operation.

runtimeIndeterminate.message: $p1$: The visible portal state could not be determined. Monitoring is paused.

portalIntervalNote.message: $p1$ checks the visible portal: $p2$. Saved interval: $p3$. Monitoring avoids parallel portal requests during session-ID changes and leaves the page’s own refresh unchanged. A custom URL bypasses monitoring and sends GET requests.

runtimePortalMonitored.message: $p1$: Portal status checked. The page’s own refresh is unchanged; no extra requests sent.
